doc_friction.issue: Step 0 says fix every open entry first, but all 11 open entries are control-plane workflow edits that already have open owner-approval PRs (#14877, #15248, #14808, #15561, #14612); redteam.py open could show the pending PR per entry so runs do not re-check them.
git merge origin/main after a depth-1 fetch says 'refusing to merge unrelated histories'; --deepen=50 fixed it. The shallow-merge note in CLAUDE.md covers it, but only under Duplicate PRs.

deviations.why: Step 4b prefers a lint for the class. A regex scan for let-variables written but never read found 32 hits across ventures; 6 sampled were harmless dead counters, so a lint would be noise.
deviations.did: Added a random-list invariant test in the target's suite instead, which fails on the old code.
deviations.result: Guard catches the defect class for this product; no repo-wide lint.

notes: Target ventures/wash-sale-checker/calc.mjs (changed on main within 2 days, money-facing). 3 campaigns x 8 mutants (suite 0.2 s). Catch 13/22 -> 20/20 non-equivalent after 9 tests. Real defect: unused rounding remainder in disallowed-loss split (phantom cent). Guard added: random-list exact-sum invariant for replacement shares. Dead-let scan (32 hits, scratch script, not committed) left as a lead. Checks: node --test (68 pass), run_venture_tests.py wash-sale-checker ok, check_post_frontmatter/check_post_links ok.

real_defects.issue: Per-replacement disallowed shares were each rounded and the rounding remainder (left) was computed but never applied, so a loss of 100.01 split over three one-share buys added 100.02 to replacement basis (a later sale's basis read 250.02, not 250.01) and IRA permanent losses could be a cent off. Reproduced with evaluate(); fixed by giving the last replacement the remainder, test 'no phantom cent'.
